name: @capiro/meri-contracts
description: Public distribution of frozen Meri wire shapes; validation grants no authorization

scripts.build: node generate.mjs && node generate-actions.mjs && node generate-documents.mjs && node generate-conversations.mjs && node generate-lifecycle.mjs && node generate-history.mjs && node generate-input.mjs && node generate-user-preferences.mjs
scripts.check:generated: node generate.mjs --check && node generate-actions.mjs --check && node generate-documents.mjs --check && node generate-conversations.mjs --check && node generate-lifecycle.mjs --check && node generate-history.mjs --check && node generate-input.mjs --check && node generate-user-preferences.mjs --check
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext test/public-types.ts test/action-application-public-types.ts test/document-application-public-types.ts test/conversation-application-public-types.ts test/conversation-lifecycle-public-types.ts test/conversation-history-public-types.ts test/conversation-input-public-types.ts test/user-preferences-application-public-types.ts
scripts.test:public: node --test test/public-package.test.mjs test/action-application-public.test.mjs test/document-application-public.test.mjs test/conversation-application-public.test.mjs test/conversation-lifecycle-public.test.mjs test/conversation-history-public.test.mjs test/conversation-history-source.test.mjs test/conversation-input-public.test.mjs test/user-preferences-application-public.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:generated && npm run typecheck && npm run test:public
